text.page_fit_note: master 209.9 x 269.9 mm is smaller than the 216 x 279 mm trim and its edges carry detail (worst step 39/255). Enlarging it to reach the cut would push its text out of the 20 mm gutter, so the page is placed 1:1: the outer 3.06 mm (sides) and 4.54 mm (top and bottom) of the printed page carry a soft continuation of the page edge. Re-export this master at 216 x 279 mm to remove it
text.content_shift_note: content moved 0.5 mm toward the outer edge and 0.0 mm down: closest live text is now 21.0 mm off the gutter (was 20.5), 20.5 mm from the outer trim (was 21.0) and 25.1 mm from the top trim (their rules: 20 mm gutter, 5 mm trim; tightest page 10, 17.4 mm off the gutter)
text.note: kept RGB: 43 Type 3 fonts block Ghostscript's CMYK conversion (guide p.6 accepts RGB, their preflight converts); transparency left on 3 pages (the flattening pass could not clear it)

checks.name: All fonts embedded
checks.detail: NOT embedded: Helvetica [/Type1], Helvetica-Bold [/Type1] -- the master references the same font (Helvetica, Helvetica-Bold), so re-export the master without it: the pack cannot embed a font whose program is not in the file

checks.name: No Type 3 glyph-program fonts
checks.detail: 43 Type 3 fonts. These carry headings as drawing programs instead of an embedded font, so preflight rates them lowest of all font types, and Ghostscript 10.02.1 segfaults converting them to CMYK -- this book therefore stays RGB, which BookVault accept and convert themselves

checks.name: Transparency flattened
checks.detail: 3 pages still carry it (page 5: transparency group); Ghostscript's flattening pass ran and left it in place, so it has to be cleared before a print run (guide p.3)

checks.name: Images at 300 DPI or better
checks.detail: 3 below 300 DPI, e.g. page 5: 93 DPI; page 7: 112 DPI; page 10: 149 DPI
